title: Arabic Club
summary: A weekly circle for learning Arabic together.
body: The Institute runs a weekly Arabic Club circle. Contact the Institute for the current schedule and how to take part.

title: Study sessions
summary: Regular spaces for study and discussion.
body: Study sessions are part of the Institute’s current work. Ask the Institute what is being studied and how to join a session.

title: Faith-centred programmes
summary: Online programmes in faith-centred personal development.
body: The Institute has organised online programmes that connect faith with personal development. Contact the Institute for current programme information.

title: Safwa Quran
summary: A digital project centred on the Qur’an, reflection and daily practice.
body: Safwa Studios is developing Safwa Quran to make room for the Qur’an and reflection in everyday life. Contact the Studios for project enquiries.
